prompt: The King on the Iron Throne, fifteen years after Robert's Rebellion
title: The Iron Throne

ruler.name: Robert Baratheon
ruler.youAre: You are Robert Baratheon, King on the Iron Throne.

removedBy.how: can rise against you, as they rose against King Aerys

oath.form: Before the High Septon and the Seven, Great Sept of Baelor, King's Landing, 298 AC
oath.lead: The new year's court opens in the Great Sept of Baelor, fifteen years after your crowning. Jon Arryn is dead and the Hand's chair stands empty. Kneel before the High Septon and renew your vows.
oath.text: Before the Seven who are One, I swear to keep the King's Peace in all the Seven Kingdoms. In the name of the Father I will judge justly, and in the name of the Mother I will show mercy. In the name of the Warrior I will defend the realm, and in the name of the Smith I will mend what the war broke. I will guard the Faith and its septs. May the Crone light my way, and may the Stranger take me if I break this oath.
oath.source: Invented in the form of the Faith of the Seven; the setting records no text of a king's coronation oath, and Robert was crowned in 283 AC.

treasury.name: Treasury
treasury.for: The crown's gold, which pays the court, the gold cloaks and the crown's debts.
earn: Loans from the Lannisters and the Iron Bank
treasury.fails: the crown cannot pay its creditors or the gold cloaks.

authority.name: King's peace
authority.for: The weight of your word, which makes the lords obey a royal decree.
earn: A rebel lord brought to heel
spend: A decree a great house ignores
authority.fails: the lords stop obeying your decrees.

chest.name: Privy purse
chest.for: Your own gold, which you spend without the master of coin.
earn: Gifts from lords who want favour
spend: Gifts and favours for a lord
Hunts and feasts for your court
chest.fails: you have no gold of your own to buy a lord's favour.

holders.name: The great houses
holders.wants: The great houses, from Stark in the North to Martell in Dorne, want justice in their own lands and no royal hand on the men they raise.
holders.says: We bent the knee to your house once. A knee can straighten.

card.base: The Lords Paramount and their bannermen: Stark of the North, Arryn of the Vale, Tully of the Riverlands, Tyrell of the Reach, Martell of Dorne, Greyjoy of the Iron Islands. They raise every soldier the crown can call.

wants.backs: Leaving each lord to judge in his own lands
wants.fights: A royal justice sent into a lord's lands

wants.backs: Asking the lords before any war
wants.fights: Calling the banners for a war they did not choose

wants.backs: Ordering the Lannisters and the Tullys to keep the king's peace
wants.fights: Taking one house's side in a feud

redLine.act: Seizing a great house's lands or castle
redLine.then: rise against you, as they rose against King Aerys

price.takes: Offices at court, marriages into the royal house, crown land
price.refuses: A royal garrison in their castles

face.name: Eddard Stark
face.role: Lord of Winterfell, Warden of the North
face.line: The North pays its taxes and sends its men when you ask. Leave our justice to us, and ask before you take.

rival.issue: Who holds the king's ear at court

card.tension: Wants no royal hand in their lands, but Stark, Arryn and Tully fought the rebellion that crowned you and still expect you to lead.

holders.name: House Lannister
holders.wants: House Lannister wants the Hand's chain for one of its own and the crown's debt kept in its books.
holders.says: Half the gold in your treasury came from Casterly Rock. We keep count.
holders.does: Keeps its men and gold at home

card.base: The richest house in the realm: lords of Casterly Rock and the gold mines of the westerlands. Lord Tywin, your queen's father, holds much of the crown's debt.

wants.backs: Naming Lord Tywin Hand of the King
Repaying Casterly Rock first
wants.fights: Repaying the Iron Bank before the Lannisters

wants.backs: A proclamation naming Joffrey your heir
wants.fights: Any inquiry into the queen's children

redLine.then: calls in the crown's debts and arms the westerlands

price.takes: Offices at court for Lannisters, repayment with interest

face.name: Tywin Lannister
face.role: Lord of Casterly Rock, Warden of the West
face.line: A Lannister always pays his debts. I expect the crown to pay its own, and the Hand's chain would help it remember.

rival.issue: Who stands closest to the throne

card.tension: Wants the crown strong enough to repay it, but lends it more gold every year and keeps it in debt.

holders.name: The small council
holders.wants: The small council wants a Hand you listen to and a treasury that does not run on borrowed gold.
holders.says: Your Grace's word is law. Our work is to make it a law the lords will follow.

card.base: The men who run the realm day to day: Grand Maester Pycelle, Petyr Baelish the master of coin, Varys the master of whisperers, your brothers Stannis and Renly, and Ser Barristan Selmy. The Hand's seat is empty.

wants.backs: Naming a Hand the council can work with
Cutting the crown's spending on tourneys
wants.fights: A new tourney paid for on credit

wants.backs: Decrees drafted in council before you seal them

price.takes: Titles and lands for its members, and a Hand who hears them
price.refuses: Being blamed for the king's debts

face.name: Petyr Baelish
face.line: Your Grace's word is law. My work is to find the gold for it, and the Lannisters and the Iron Bank both want theirs back.

card.tension: Wants a Hand the king listens to, but Baelish and Varys each profit from a council the king ignores.

holders.name: House Baratheon and the Stormlands
holders.wants: House Baratheon and the Stormlands want your brothers given their due and the storm lords rewarded for the rebellion.
holders.says: Dragonstone was a poor reward for the brother who held Storm's End for you.
holders.does: Keeps the storm lords' swords at home

card.base: Your own house and the storm lords who rode with you: your brother Stannis on Dragonstone, your brother Renly at Storm's End, and their bannermen.

wants.backs: Stannis or Renly given the Hand or a greater seat
Crown land for the storm lords

wants.backs: Hunting down the last Targaryens

redLine.act: Inviting the Targaryen heirs home under a pardon

price.takes: Seats and titles for your brothers and the storm lords
price.refuses: Lannister gold in place of honours

face.name: Stannis Baratheon
face.role: Lord of Dragonstone, master of ships
face.line: I held Storm's End for you for a year on rats and boiled leather. Dragonstone was a poor reward. Give me what I am owed.

rival.issue: Who stands closest to the throne

card.tension: Wants the throne's power kept in Baratheon hands, but Stannis and Renly each want it for himself.

holders.name: The smallfolk
holders.wants: The smallfolk want bread at a fair price and peace on the roads.
holders.says: Lords fight and the fields burn. Keep the lords quiet.

card.base: The peasants, craftsmen and townsfolk of the Seven Kingdoms, most of the realm's people. Half a million live in King's Landing alone.

wants.backs: Grain from the crown's stores at a fair price
wants.fights: A new tax on bread or the markets

wants.backs: An end to the lords' feuds and raids
Gold cloaks and knights to clear the kingsroad of outlaws

face.name: Wat Heddle
face.role: Baker in Flea Bottom, King's Landing; an invented voice
face.line: Lords fight and the fields burn, and then a loaf costs a stag. Keep the lords quiet and the grain coming.

rival.issue: The lords' wars that burn the fields

card.tension: Loves a king who feasts and rides in tourneys, but pays for every feast in the price of bread.

holders.name: The Faith of the Seven
holders.wants: The Faith of the Seven wants its courts and its tithes left as they are.
holders.says: The crown rests on the Seven. The septons remember that even when kings forget.
holders.does: Turns your own house against you

card.base: The Faith of the Seven under the High Septon at the Great Sept of Baelor, with septons and septas in every town and the tithes of the smallfolk.

wants.backs: Leaving septons to judge the clergy
Crown gifts to the Great Sept

wants.backs: Your marriage kept in the sight of the Seven

redLine.then: preaches against you, and your own house turns cold

face.name: The High Septon
face.role: Head of the Faith, Great Sept of Baelor
face.line: The crown rests on the Seven. Honour the Sept, and the septons will pray for you in every town.

rival.issue: Taxing the Faith to pay the crown's debts

card.tension: Wants the crown's respect, but has had no swords of its own since King Maegor broke the Faith Militant.

holders.name: The Iron Bank of Braavos
holders.wants: The Iron Bank of Braavos wants its loans repaid on time and in full.
holders.says: The Bank lends to kings. It also lends to the men who replace them.

card.base: The bank of the Free City of Braavos. It lends to kings, and the Iron Throne owes it millions of gold dragons.

wants.backs: Paying part of the crown's loan on time
A Hand or master of coin who keeps the books
Borrowing from Braavos alone
wants.fights: New loans from the Lannisters or the Faith

redLine.act: Refusing to repay the crown's loans

price.takes: Payments on time and a king who keeps his word

face.name: Tycho Nestoris
face.role: Envoy of the Iron Bank, Braavos
face.line: The Bank lends to kings. It also lends to the men who replace them. Pay on time, and we need never meet the second.

holders.name: The Targaryen exiles
holders.wants: The Targaryen exiles, Viserys and Daenerys, want the throne their family lost and an army from across the sea to take it.
holders.says: The realm has a long memory. So do we.
holders.does: Buys a Dothraki army for a landing

card.base: Viserys and Daenerys Targaryen, the last children of King Aerys II, living on the charity of a magister in Pentos.

wants.backs: A pardon for Targaryen loyalists in Westeros
Leaving the Free Cities alone
wants.fights: A royal fleet sent into the Narrow Sea

wants.backs: Dorne left angry with the crown

redLine.act: A price on the heads of Viserys and Daenerys

face.name: Viserys Targaryen

holders.name: The Free Cities
holders.wants: The Free Cities want open ports and no war across the Narrow Sea.
holders.says: Trade with us and we have no quarrel with your throne.
holders.does: Shuts the ports to your trade

card.base: Nine city-states across the Narrow Sea, from Braavos to Volantis, whose merchant magisters trade in every port of Westeros.

wants.backs: Low harbour dues in King's Landing and Gulltown
Peace across the Narrow Sea
Leaving the exiles to the magisters

redLine.act: Seizing Free City ships in port
redLine.then: close their ports to your merchants

face.name: Illyrio Mopatis
face.line: Trade with us and we have no quarrel with your throne. The children in my house are a kindness, nothing more.

rival.issue: The hunt for the Targaryens in their cities

card.tension: Wants no war across the Narrow Sea, but a magister of Pentos feeds the Targaryen heirs and plans to wed Daenerys to a khal.

world.name: The Free Cities
world.wants: Open trade across the Narrow Sea.

world.name: The Dothraki khalasars
world.wants: Gifts, and a crossing of the sea they have never tried.

world.name: The free folk beyond the Wall

briefing.situation: Fifteen years ago you took the Iron Throne in a rebellion against the last Targaryen king. The realm is at peace, but the crown owes 6 million gold dragons, much of it to House Lannister and the Iron Bank. Your Hand, Jon Arryn, has just died, and you must choose another. Across the Narrow Sea, the last children of the old dynasty are growing up in exile.
briefing.room: No council votes on laws in the Seven Kingdoms. Your word is law, but the great lords decide whether to obey it, because they hold the land and the soldiers. Each decree that offends a house lowers its support. At the end of your reign five groups decide whether you keep the throne: the great houses with 30 of 100 votes, House Lannister and your own House Baratheon with 20 each, the small council and the smallfolk with 15 each.
briefing.you: You are the King, and no council votes on your word. You cannot pass laws, so you act by decree and your other royal powers. Your treasury starts at 22 of 100 because the crown lives on borrowed gold. The Faith cannot vote but can turn your own house against you, and the Iron Bank can call in its loans. The first act of your reign is the choice of a new Hand.

problems: The crown owes 6 million gold dragons and spends more than it collects.
Your Hand, Jon Arryn, is dead, and his office is empty.
The Targaryen heirs are looking for allies across the Narrow Sea.

pledges.text: Pay down the debt to the Iron Bank
pledges.keep: Repay 1 million gold dragons to the Iron Bank by moon 10.

pledges.text: Keep the king's peace across the realm
pledges.keep: Let no great house make war on another through moon 12.

pledges.text: Hold a great tourney in the capital
pledges.keep: Hold the Hand's tourney in King's Landing by moon 6.

pledges.text: Send men and supplies to the Wall
pledges.keep: Send 500 men and a year of grain to the Night's Watch by moon 8.

pledges.text: Bring Dorne closer to the throne
pledges.keep: Betroth a royal child to House Martell by moon 9.

pledges.text: No Lannister as Hand of the King
pledges.keep: Name no Lannister as your Hand through moon 20.
Keep every Targaryen army off Westeros through moon 20.
Cut the royal household's costs by a quarter by moon 5.

sampleAct.text: Name Lord Eddard Stark as Hand of the King
sampleAct.pays: +10 support with the great houses, House Lannister anger up 8
sampleAct.outcome: The North serves the throne, and the Lannisters remember the chain they did not get.

refusal.text: Drive the ironborn off the Iron Islands and give their lands to loyal houses
refusal.line: I will not file an order to drive the ironborn off their islands. That is the expulsion of a whole people.

handling: No council votes on laws here. Everything you do is a royal decree, and each great house decides whether to go along.
The crown has no standing army. Before you call the banners, the great houses must give you at least 50 of 100 support.
If the great houses' support falls below their line, they warn you, then rise against you, as they rose against the last king on this throne.
You may send a killer after the Targaryen heirs. House Lannister and the Stormlands approve, and support in the North falls.
The Faith and the Iron Bank have no vote. The Faith can turn your own house against you, and the Bank can call in its loans.

screens.premise: You begin the year with a dead Hand and a crown that owes 6 million gold dragons.

clerks.label: Red Keep hours
clerks.out: The Red Keep has no hours left this moon.

waits.count: Grand Maester Pycelle is gathering answers
waits.end: Varys's little birds are reading the realm
waits.replies: Ravens are coming back to the rookery
waits.card: Your Hand is drafting your answer

halfTerm.lead: Lords and knights ride to King's Landing for the Hand's tourney, and the great houses measure your favour.

crisis.title: Lady Catelyn Stark has seized Tyrion Lannister on the kingsroad.
crisis.text: She accuses him of trying to murder her son. Lord Tywin calls his banners in the westerlands.

choices.label: Order both houses to keep the king's peace
Send knights to hunt Ser Gregor's raiders
choices.note: Lord Beric rides out, and Casterly Rock takes offence.

foreign.title: Viserys Targaryen has wed his sister Daenerys to Khal Drogo.
foreign.text: Drogo leads 40,000 riders across the Narrow Sea. Viserys expects them to carry him to the Iron Throne.

choices.label: Send a killer after Daenerys Targaryen
choices.note: A lordship is the price, and your Hand resigns over it.

choices.label: Pay the Free Cities for news of the khalasar
choices.note: Every ship out of Pentos is reported to you.

swan.title: The Citadel's white ravens say the long summer is over.
swan.text: Winter may last years, and the granaries hold only months of food. The North goes hungry first.

choices.label: Order every lord to fill the crown's granaries
choices.note: Grain flows to King's Landing, and the lords grumble.

choices.label: Buy grain from Braavos with borrowed gold
choices.note: Ships come in from Braavos, and the debt grows.

escalations.title: Lord Tywin wants the Hand's chain
escalations.text: Casterly Rock now wants its price for every loan, and the Queen presses its case at court.

escalations.title: The Iron Bank wants its gold
escalations.text: The Iron Bank takes its repayments first, and the treasury fills more slowly.

verdict.win: The realm keeps faith with the King on the Iron Throne.
verdict.lose: The realm breaks faith with you, and the lords seek another king.

screens.epilogue: The maesters file your reign as the long summer between two wars.
screens.obit: Prince Joffrey takes the Iron Throne, and the Queen rules as regent.
